Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Henry Roth was "from England" despite the WebSurfer results clearly stating that Henry Roth was born in Galicia, Austro-Hungary (now Ukraine). The Planner failed to distinguish birthplace from nationality and misinterpreted the data, erroneously associating Henry Roth with England. Additionally, the Planner overlooked the fact that Robert Erskine Childers was explicitly identified as being born in London, England, which directly contradicted its final conclusion. This misstep led to the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
